title: ADR-0004: provision and teardown temporary test databases on user-scoped service
description:
Add operator/agent workflow to create a throwaway Dolt database name (coherence_test_<uuid>) on the user-scoped server, run migrations and tests, then drop database on success.

Goal: CI and local make test-isolated use explicit disposable DB identity per ADR-0004 shared-service shape; no accidental reuse of project slug.

Scope: shell helpers and/or small Rust subcommand create-test-db / drop-test-db OR documented dolt sql -q CREATE DATABASE flow; wire Makefile targets to export DOLT_DB for the run.

Integrate with with-isolated-test-profile or successor so each CI job gets unique DOLT_DB.

Do NOT: drop canonical project databases; require manual confirmation for any destructive op beyond test prefix.
design: CREATE DATABASE coherence_test_*; run migrate; tests; DROP DATABASE on success. On failure optional COHERENCE_KEEP_TEST_WORLD preserves name for inspection.
acceptance_criteria:
make test-isolated (or CI) sets unique DOLT_DB under profile=test when user-scoped service is configured.

Documented fallback: repo-local .dolt path still works for environments without shared service.

Teardown drops only databases matching coherence_test_ prefix (or configured pattern).

Verification: two consecutive CI-style runs do not share fixture state; canonical slug DB untouched.

Close: disposable test world lifecycle works on ADR-0006 topology.
close_reason: with-isolated-test-profile assigns unique coherence_test_* DOLT_DB when COHERENCE_USE_USER_SCOPED_DOLT is set, drops via drop-isolated-test-db on success (prefix-guarded); repo-local/CI unchanged without user-scoped. Documented in scripts/help and AGENTS.md.

title: ADR-0004: harden test-world guard using resolved DB identity
description:
Extend test_world_guard beyond COHERENCE_DB_PROFILE=test so mutating tests/smoke cannot target the canonical project database by mistake.

Goal: refusal is based on resolved ConnectionConfig (database name and optionally socket path), aligned with ADR-0004 stricter wording: check resolved config, not only raw env.

When COHERENCE_PROJECT_SLUG (or equivalent) is set, refuse writes if resolved DOLT_DB equals that slug (case-normalize per product rules).

When profile=test, require DOLT_DB to look like a disposable test world (prefix coherence_test_ or explicit allow-list env) OR require inequality with canonical slug.

Keep error messages actionable: Cause, Next targets, Fix lines consistent with existing STANDARD_REMEDIATION_TARGETS.

Do NOT: implement full evidence store; change verify semantics.
design: Shared helper takes ConnectionConfig after from_env(); centralize rules in test_world_guard. Optional second line of defense: COHERENCE_TEST_WORLD explicit name must match DOLT_DB when set.
acceptance_criteria:
Unit tests cover: profile=test but DOLT_DB equals canonical slug when COHERENCE_PROJECT_SLUG set => refuse.

profile=test and DOLT_DB coherence_test_<uuid> => allow.

profile unset => refuse unchanged.

Smoke commands call guard after building ConnectionConfig or pass config into guard.

Do NOT: silently change migrate behavior for canonical sessions without product sign-off.

Verification: cargo test; manual smoke with wrong DOLT_DB shows explicit refusal.

Close: ADR-0004 guard matches resolved DB identity rule from updated ADR text.
close_reason: Hardened test_world_guard: require_isolated_test_world_for_writes now takes resolved ConnectionConfig; user-scoped Dolt rejects matching COHERENCE_PROJECT_SLUG and non-disposable db names plus optional COHERENCE_TEST_WORLD/allowlist COHERENCE_TEST_WORLD_DB_ALLOWLIST; repo-local .dolt keeps profile=test-only. Smoke crates build config before guard per ADR-0004.

title: ADR-0006: user-scoped Dolt service launcher and tool defaults
description:

Goal: coherence-core-db and scripts default to socket plus database name; repo-local .dolt remains a supported dev fallback or is clearly secondary per product decision.

Scope: launcher scripts (start/stop/status), directory layout under XDG, readiness via socket, pid/log/port metadata as private launcher state. Update ConnectionConfig::from_env defaults or documented precedence so tools match ADR-0006 when COHERENCE_USE_USER_SCOPED_DOLT=1 or equivalent explicit opt-in.

Do NOT: require TCP host/port in user-facing project config; break CI without a documented path (e.g. continue to support disposable repo-local .dolt for agents that do not install user service yet).
design: Single service owns ~/.local/share/coherence/db as data-dir; each project is a Dolt database name matching slug; socket at XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/coherence/dolt.sock with fallback to ~/.cache/coherence/run per ADR. TCP port is ephemeral or fixed internal only.
acceptance_criteria:
Documented layout matches ADR-0006 (data dir, runtime dir, socket path).

Launcher can start/stop/restart service idempotently; verifies readiness through MySQL protocol over socket.

coherence-core-db connects with DOLT_SOCKET + DOLT_DB against user-scoped service in a manual smoke.

Default documented env example: DOLT_SOCKET points at user socket, DOLT_DB is project slug.

Do NOT: migrate beads or other tools tables beyond core-db ownership in this task unless already in scope.

Verification: manual or scripted flow — start service, migrate, spec list on two different DOLT_DB names without port conflicts; dolt-stop cleans process; no requirement for per-repo dolt server for that flow.

Close: ADR-0006 local shape is operable and documented for core-db operators.
close_reason: ADR-0006 user-scoped dolt: launcher scripts (COHERENCE_USE_USER_SCOPED_DOLT), XDG data/runtime/socket defaults, db-ping readiness via mysql crate over unix socket, ConnectionConfig coordinated defaults + CREATE DATABASE when opt-in, migrate/help/doctor/AGENTS docs, scripts/user-scoped-dolt-smoke.sh verification.
